messages.content:
How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

message.reasoning: We need to produce a RESTful API request. The user wants to know how to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard. They provide version, IP, API name, and parameters. We need to output the request. According to the tool, we can call functions.requests_get with the URL and params. The URL endpoint: 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'. So we need to call the function with url: 'https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo', and params: {fabricName: 'Network1', nodeId: 12, podId: 10, interfaceType: 'Ethernet', infoType: 'Speed'}. But note that interfaceType expects one of "gigabitethernet" | "fastethernet" | "ethernet" | "serial". The user gave "Ethernet" capitalized. Should we convert to lowercase? The function expects "ethernet". So we should pass "ethernet". Also infoType expects "statistics" | "status" | "config" | "Speed". The last one is "Speed" with capital S. The function expects "Speed" exactly? It says "Speed". So we pass "Speed". So we call the function. Then we need to output the result. The function will return some JSON. We need to output that. The user asked: "How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?" They want the request. So we should show the request. Possibly we should show the GET request with query parameters. Then we can call the function to get the response. So we do that.
